comment: The one upstream commit this overlay is maintained against, and the patch it applies. The experimental durable app is source-only upstream, so its runtime is a pinned checkout plus this patch, provisioned by the operator; Entwurf ships neither. A checkout's TRACKED tree counts as this overlay only when HEAD equals commit, `git diff` equals the patch bytes exactly, and no non-ignored file is untracked. Git-ignored runtime inputs are outside that equality and are described separately below.

modelData.comment: Git-ignored generated model data the runtime imports at open. Upstream hydrates it by calling vendor model-list endpoints; this overlay instead takes the bytes the v1.0.2 release built from this commit, from the published package below, with no network. aggregateSha256 is sha256 over one `<sha256 of file>  <file name>\n` line per *.json file (dotfiles excluded), names in C byte order. upstream `packages/ai/scripts/check-model-data.ts` validates these bytes against the manifest.
